cohort: Two cohorts of nondiabetic low risk women at term without preexisting indications for cesarean
finding: The policy of discussing the risk of macrosomia with SEFW ≥ 4,000 g to women did not lead to a difference in shoulder dystocia rates but did increase the odds of CS
mod_finding: The odds ratio for CS was 9.0 (95% confidence interval, 5.3-15.4) when macrosomia was correctly suspected.
